definitions.explanation: Something that causes offense or has a negative impact on others. Most commonly used in the negative form.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繋|つな}いだ→繋ぐ：01962_tsunagu⟧。
examples.english: I kept the conversation going with safe topics.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧こと⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦つまらない→つまらない：00590_tsumaranai⟧。
examples.english: It's boring to only say things that won't offend anyone.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the negative form {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, meaning "inoffensive," "harmless," or "noncommittal." The positive form is rarely used.
Using {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ language can be seen as tactful in Japanese culture, but it can also suggest avoiding taking a clear position or being evasive.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧ - safe/harmless conversation
- {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧ - noncommittal reply
- {当|あ}たり{障|さわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ - inoffensive expression
